Name: Eliada, Captain of Benjamin
Summary: Eliada, a mighty man of valour of Benjamin, commanded two hundred thousand armed men with bow and shield under Jehoshaphat.
KeyStory: Of Benjamin, Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
